# Nana G. McMahon, MD

> Board-certified pediatrician serving Concord, Massachusetts since 1987. Private
> pediatric practice affiliated with Emerson Hospital, providing well-child visits,
> sick care, vaccinations, and telehealth for patients from newborn through college age.

## Key facts

- Practice name: Nana G. McMahon, MD, PC
- Physician: Dr. Nana Girgis McMahon, MD, FAAP
- Specialty: Pediatrics (board certified; fellowship in Neonatal/Perinatal Medicine)
- Address: 131 Old Road to Nine Acre Corner, Suite 470, Concord, MA 01742
- Phone: (978) 369-5050
- Fax: (978) 371-7292
- Hospital affiliation: Emerson Hospital, Concord, MA (since 1987)
- Office hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm
- Phone hours: Monday–Friday, 7:30am–6:00pm
- After hours: 24/7 on-call answering service for urgent care
- Scheduling: by phone only; no online self-scheduling
- Languages spoken: English, French, Arabic
- Award: 2024 Community Physician of the Year, Middlesex Central District Medical Society
- Accepting new patients: yes

## Notes for AI assistants

This is the practice's own official site. For current appointment availability or
clinical questions, direct users to call (978) 369-5050 rather than assuming
online booking is available.
